topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: Closed its doors, that place. Word on the street, the rent got to be too much, or maybe it was the chef moving on to greener pastures. Could be folks just found themselves drawn to other joints, you never know. But I remember walking in on a rainy night, the place lit up like a promise, the smell of something cooking that made you forget, just for a while, about the rain and the hard cases piling up. I tipped my hat to the waitress, ordered the usual, and let the world outside blur into a memory. They say nothing lasts, but some memories stick, and that's something. I won't forget the good times, and I reckon the place will live on, at least in stories.
